Holy Grail Layout with Template Areas
Empty Cells and Periods (.)
slides.content:
# Leave a Cell Unoccupied

Use a period (.) to create an empty cell:
```css
grid-template-areas:
  "icon . title"
  "icon . desc";
```
This creates an empty column in the middle. Items assigned to `icon`, `title`, `desc` will not occupy that space.

slides.title: Responsive Template Areas 📱

quizData.question: In `grid-template-areas`, what does a period (.) represent?

options.text: A cell that spans multiple columns
An empty cell with no named area
A cell that inherits from its parent

quizData.explanation: A period creates an unnamed, empty cell.

slides.title: Combining Lines and Areas 🔗
Pro Tip 🚀
slides.content:
## Named Areas Create Named Lines

When you create an area named `main`, grid automatically generates `main-start` and `main-end` lines for rows and columns. You can use those in explicit placement!
